description: Pre-game plans changed late, and assistant staff need to know which tactical notes, substitution plans, player restrictions, and last-minute instructions are still current on match day. All team names are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 39-year-old match operations coordinator supporting a coaching staff under time pressure
user_profile.context: Several late adjustments were made verbally, and the staff now risks acting on outdated plans
user_profile.communication_style: Fast and operational, wants the current plan separated from discarded ideas

The primary pressing trigger is any backward pass made by River Valley's central midfielders.
Kaelen Ross (#10) is instructed to play as a 'false nine', dropping deep to link with the midfield.
Full-backs are authorized to overlap only when the ball is securely in the opponent's final third.
DISCARDED PLAN: The initial 4-4-2 diamond formation has been scrapped due to opponent's wide threat.
DISCARDED PLAN: The man-to-man marking scheme for set pieces is no longer in effect; we have switched to zonal.
Liam Jensen (#7) is on a strict 60-minute playing time limit as per Dr. Evans' final assessment.
Ben Carter (#4) is one yellow card away from a suspension and must avoid unnecessary challenges.
Goalkeeper Samira Khan (#1) is cleared to play but must only take goal kicks with her left foot due to a minor calf strain.
Marco Diaz (#11) passed his late fitness test at 11:00 AM and is confirmed for the starting lineup.
Aiden Chen (#18) reported a mild headache this morning but was cleared by medical staff at 12:15 PM.

Second planned substitution: If we are trailing after 70 minutes, Noah Patel (#19), an attacker, will replace Ben Carter (#4), a defender.
Third planned substitution is tactical and at the discretion of Head Coach Valerius, with a preference for subbing a midfielder.

CURRENT: Kaelen Ross (#10) will take all right-sided corner kicks.
CURRENT: Maria Flores (#6) will take all left-sided corner kicks and direct free kicks within 30 yards.
CURRENT: For defensive corners, our two tallest players, Ivan Petrov (#5) and Ben Carter (#4), will mark the 6-yard box.
CURRENT: Marco Diaz (#11) is assigned to the top of the box for defensive corners to initiate counter-attacks.
DISCARDED PLAN: Ivan Petrov (#5) is no longer the primary penalty kick taker; Kaelen Ross (#10) is now designated.
The team will wear the primary blue home kit. The alternate white kit must also be brought to the stadium.
Northwood FC is assigned to home locker room #A-101 at Oakwood Stadium.
On-field warm-up begins exactly at 6:45 PM, led by fitness coach Ramirez.
Post-game meal consists of grilled chicken, quinoa, and steamed vegetables, to be delivered to the locker room at 9:30 PM.
All match-worn GPS units must be returned to kit manager Leo Finch's station by 10:00 PM.
All real-time tactical adjustments during the match must be communicated via the #matchday-live Slack channel.
Head Coach Valerius has the final say on all in-game decisions; his verbal command overrides any pre-written plan.
The official, finalized team sheet was submitted to the league official by Manager Anya Sharma at 5:30 PM.
Any urgent medical issues must be reported directly to Dr. Evans on radio channel 3.
River Valley's striker, #9 Jonas Schmidt, has scored 5 of his last 6 goals in the final 15 minutes of a match.
River Valley's left-back, #3, is known for aggressive forward runs, creating space to counter-attack behind him.
The pre-match team talk by Coach Valerius is scheduled for 6:15 PM in locker room #A-101.
